from pathlib import Path
import contextlib, hashlib, io, json, resource, signal, sys, time
root=Path.cwd()
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(170,175)); signal.alarm(180)
started=time.monotonic()
paths=[root/'peano-lab/py/tests'/n for n in ('test_alpha_v32_ui.py','test_alpha_v33_ui.py')]
def pins():
 return {str(p.relative_to(root)):{'bytes':len(p.read_bytes()),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for p in paths}
before=pins()
for p in (root/'scripts',root/'peano-lab/py'):sys.path.insert(0,str(p))
import pytest
class Inventory:
 def __init__(self):self.ids=[];self.bad=False
 def pytest_collection_modifyitems(self,session,config,items):self.ids=[x.nodeid for x in items]
 def pytest_collectreport(self,report):self.bad |= report.failed or report.skipped
inventory=Inventory(); output=io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output),contextlib.redirect_stderr(output):
 status=int(pytest.main(['--collect-only','-q',*(str(p) for p in paths)],plugins=[inventory]))
assert status==0 and not inventory.bad and before==pins()
assert len(inventory.ids)==len(set(inventory.ids))==171
assert 'peano_lab.library.editions_v33' not in sys.modules
by={p.name:[x for x in inventory.ids if x.startswith('peano-lab/py/tests/'+p.name+'::')] for p in paths}
assert {n:len(ids) for n,ids in by.items()}=={'test_alpha_v32_ui.py':92,'test_alpha_v33_ui.py':79}
peak=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss
assert peak<=1610612736
signal.alarm(0)
print(json.dumps({'schema':'alpha-v33-ui-two-file-collection-diagnostic-v1','proof_authority':False,'collect_only':True,'executed_cases':0,'pytest_status':status,'counts':{n:len(ids) for n,ids in by.items()},'ids_sha256':{n:hashlib.sha256('\n'.join(ids).encode()).hexdigest() for n,ids in by.items()},'source_pins':before,'seconds':time.monotonic()-started,'peak_rss_bytes':peak,'cpu_limits':list(resource.getrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU)),'wall_seconds':180,'alpha_imported':False},sort_keys=True))
